extra_quotes: The outputs of the two OIL lasers are combined and spectrally conditioned using a programmable optical filter (WaveShaper, Coherent, 1000A), followed by amplification with an EDFA (Thorlabs, EDFA100P) and attenuation with a variable optical attenuator (ATT).

The measured value of −95.7 dBc/Hz, however, does not necessarily represent the intrinsic phase-noise floor of the generated THz signal because the measurement is also affected by the phase noise of the LO and the measurement system.
The measured THz phase noise approaches the multiplied-LO phase noise, suggesting that the measurement is predominantly limited by the LO system in this frequency region.
